review:
A fast cop-and-robber 5x3 – money, fast cars, handcuffs and doughnuts – full of collect features: money collects, expanding wilds, extra collects, and big rewards when the cops put a criminal away.

The defining moment comes at the end of free spins: one final bust can pay a big reward if it succeeds, so the whole round builds towards that climax. Up to 10,500x, 96.5% RTP. Lighter-hearted than most collect games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
